# Per-repository Claude review cycle

This repository is enrolled (`enabled: true`); execution requires `readiness: ready`.
Pending application profiles ask the owner visibly and cannot edit or publish.
Controller unit tests do not establish application correctness. Fix rounds have
no count cap; failure, duplicate, stale-event, safety and human-input stops remain.
No auto-merge. Secrets are registered through GitHub Actions separately and never
stored in this repository. Read CONTRACT.md and config.json for exact gates.
